readable.description: False when the picture is not a readable page of handwriting (too dark, blurred, cut off, or no writing in it): then `words` is empty and `fix_first` says what to do about the photo. True otherwise.

words.description: One entry for each word of the request's `words`, in the same order and the same number, when `readable`; empty when not.

word.description: The model word, copied from the request's `words` at this place.

mark.description: 'right' the word is written exactly as the model has it; 'missing' the word is not on the page where it belongs; 'wrong' it is on the page but not as the model has it.

problem.description: For a 'wrong' word only: what is wrong in plain words, naming the letter, accent, breathing or vowel point, with the word as he wrote it: 'you wrote begining; the second e is an i'. Left out for 'right' and 'missing'.

sounds_alike.description: For a 'wrong' word of a dictated page only: true when what he wrote sounds like the model word when read aloud (another word that sounds the same, or the sound spelled another way): he heard it right and wrote it wrongly. Left out otherwise.

fix_first.description: One short sentence, kind and plain: the one thing to fix first (or, when every word is right, a word of praise; when the page was unreadable, what to do about the photo).
